semester: 4th or 6th Semester, annually in summer semester

learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the special aspects and characteristic values of constructive lightweight design and can apply them in the evaluation and selection of materials under the aspect of sustainability.
Students understand the specific material behavior of various lightweight materials and can compare and analyze them.
Students can explain the specific properties of material groups with their microstructure and alloying concept.
Students develop skills to evaluate the application potential of different material groups with regard to lightweight potential and to apply them in component design.
Students understand the special aspects of material behavior at high temperatures and can evaluate the relevance of this behavior in terms of application.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of relevant material characteristics with regard to lightweight design in relation to material requirements
